title: Occupancy and Residency Certification: Co-Borrower Allowance Read From the Monitored HECM Loan
content:
For an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile reclassified after a certifying borrower's death, the survivor allowance added to a passed due date includes a **co-borrower allowance**. It is read from the Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan the profile monitors — the co-borrower that loan record names, and the loan's status:

| The monitored HECM loan | Co-borrower allowance |
|---|---|
| names a co-borrower and its status is active | 15 days |
| names a co-borrower and its status is not active | 7 days |
| names no co-borrower | zero days |
| the profile monitors no HECM loan (a Summit loan, for instance) | zero days |

## Points of judgement

- Both parts of the first row must hold: a co-borrower named on the HECM loan, and the loan's status shown as active.
- Any status other than active — for example due and payable — falls in the second row when a co-borrower is named.
- A profile monitoring a Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage loan has no HECM loan to read, so the allowance is zero days.
